metadata.description: Advisor-driven adversarial loop with an independent reviewer gate and narrow operator-only-input escalation

plugins.name: advisor-consensus
plugins.description: Unanswered advisor notes re-prompt the main session; when the advisor is silent an independent reviewer re-prompts if the goal is unmet. Escalates only for operator-only input: a physical action, a device that is off or missing, a photo, or an unusable capture.
